name: Aquementas

narrative.details:
Take this bag of supplies with you to Tanaris. Travel to Lost Rigger Cove, and look for a circle of stones.

The eastmost peninsula is the secret...

From this circle only, read from the book of Aquor; summon the only creature that can transform the items you collected into a totem to fight Blazerunner.

Aquementas will not be pleased to be awakened, but remember, you must remain in the circle for him to transform the items.
narrative.objectives:
Take the Book of Aquor, the Silvery Claws, and the Irontree Heart to Tanaris.

Use the Book of Aquor to summon Aquementas.

After you have the completed totem, take it to J.D. Collie in Marshal's Refuge.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Blazerunner, you say...

Yes, I am aware that a strong elemental resides in the charred center of the crater. We all just keep our distance; none have been able to penetrate the powerful aura that surrounds him. Many have been pushed from the rocky paths onto the ground below when trying to face him.
narrative.requestItemsText: So you're back, eh? Hmm... Let me take a look at that, adventurer.

chain.subtitle: 13 quests from level 52 to 56, 56,900 XP in all.

quests.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
quests.objectiveText: Look around in the pond for a clue about who this wrecked raft may belong to.

quests.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
quests.objectiveText: Examine the items inside the pack and bring them to their owner.

quests.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
quests.objectiveText: Take Linken's Sword to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

quests.name: The Videre Elixir
quests.objectiveText: Seek out Gregan Brewspewer in northern Feralas.

quests.name: Meet at the Grave
quests.objectiveText: Go to the graveyard outside Gadgetzan, and use the Videre Elixir.

quests.name: A Grave Situation
quests.objectiveText: Resurrect, then look for the gravestone that Gaeriyan told you to find.

quests.name: Linken's Sword
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Linken's Superior Sword to Linken in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: A Gnome's Assistance
quests.objectiveText: Find J.D. Collie in the cave at Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: Linken's Memory
quests.objectiveText: Find Eridan Bluewind in southern Felwood.

quests.name: Silver Heart
quests.objectiveText: Collect 11 Silvery Claws and 1 Irontree Heart for Eridan Bluewind in Felwood.

quests.name: Aquementas
quests.objectiveText: Take the Book of Aquor, the Silvery Claws, and the Irontree Heart to Tanaris. Use the Book of Aquor to summon Aquementas. After you have the completed totem, take it to J.D.

quests.name: Linken's Adventure
quests.objectiveText: Take the Silver Totem of Aquementas to Linken in Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: It's Dangerous to Go Alone
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Fire Plume Ridge, south of Marshal's Refuge. Find Blazerunner and use the totem to remove his protective aura.
